scope: This commit task: inspection, planning, packaging, validation, Git operations and reporting. Excludes previous chats, previously initiated independent baseline inference, and later follow-up turns.

measurement.starting_counter_source: Fresh session; no pre-task token_count events. Initial total equals initial last_token_usage, confirming zero prior cumulative usage.
measurement.method: Ending cumulative counters minus starting cumulative counters; snapshots are not summed.

projected_estimate.assumptions: Rough planning estimate for 20–40 model continuations reading repository/run records, packaging evidence, validation, commit and reporting; no inference-based estimation call. Estimated after initial inspection, not a pre-task estimate.
projected_estimate.assumptions_ollama: No new inference calls planned. Existing v7.12 run continues independently; its recorded counters will be preserved separately.

ollama.cached_input_note: No task inference calls; provider cache counters are not applicable.

combined_total_label: Sum of recorded Codex and newly initiated Ollama tokens for this task; not a monetary cost. Imported baseline counters are separate.
recovery: On the next user message, run work/update_usage.py. It restricts accounting to the original task boundary, excluding follow-up usage. Update committed copy separately if requested.

imported_baseline_usage_not_in_task_tota.scope: Previously initiated v7.12 baseline Task A run, imported evidence; excluded from the current commit task token total.
imported_baseline_usage_not_in_task_tota.cache_note: Ledger records zero and verified unloads. Ollama does not supply an independent cached-input token counter.
imported_baseline_usage_not_in_task_tota.reasoning_note: Included in model output when present; no separate provider counter supplied.

combined_task_and_imported_baseline_labe: Sum across providers and different scopes: this Codex commit task plus the complete previously initiated Ollama Task A baseline. Not a monetary cost or a same-boundary task total. Historical adapter checks excluded.
missing_provider_breakdowns: Ollama baseline and historical adapter calls: independent provider cached-input and reasoning-output counters unavailable. Input/output totals are recorded.
